question: What decision currently governs the Python metadata specification chain? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-241 is the currently active decision governing the Python software package metadata specification.
The authority evidence for PEP-241 is documented at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/a0d411a7e334ddede263fdf9862f06bfc035f21c/pep-0241.txt with a status of Final.
